## Purpose

Get one file on disk.

## Learning objectives

- Create a file from the shell.

## Concepts to teach

- Files exist.

## Suggested progression

Create `src/answer.txt` with one line in it.

## Completion condition

`src/answer.txt` exists and is not empty.
